title: core: risk remediation R-14 (stale cache) + R-27 (silent language drop)
description:
[from board/docs/risks-v2.md · exec plan: docs/v2-execution-plan.md · batch B2/B3]
Seats: CORE-07 (owner of pipeline.rs/store.rs), INTEL-04 (TS/JS wiring)
Two MATERIALIZED defects found and proved by RISK-2, both in CORE-7's files. Fix them here (or CORE-7 fixes them before closing and this card closes with that evidence — either way they must not evaporate):
R-14 — stale analysis: store::cache_valid compares only max(mtime) at whole-second granularity (walk.rs mtime_secs uses as_secs), so a same-second edit, a git checkout/touch -r that preserves mtime, or an edit of a non-newest file is a cache HIT and stale analysis is served silently. Fix: per-file stamp = mtime in NANOSECONDS + size (or line count), compared per file, never a global max. Add a regression test that fails loudly: two writes in the same second, and a preserved-mtime edit, must both invalidate. Verify hook: grep -n as_secs crates/core/src/walk.rs -> 0 lines; the new store test passes.
R-27 — silent language drop: pipeline::build_index dispatches only rust/python and the `_` arm returns empty vectors with no warning, so TS/JS (and every other language) indexes as files with 0 symbols / 0 edges while the UI reports the language as valid. This blocks F9 end-to-end: INTEL-4's analyzer is never called. Fix: dispatch through crate::analyze (Lang::from_walk) so rust/python/typescript/javascript all extract, and for genuinely unsupported languages emit an explicit count (e.g. LearnProgress/unsupported list) instead of silence. Verify hook: map on a TS-only dir reports non-zero symbols; an unsupported-language dir reports explicitly 'not analyzed'.
Verify overall: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace; plus the two per-risk hooks above quoted in EVIDENCE.
